messages:
alerts-bot: 🔔 PROD alert: ReplicaSet inference-service-v27 experiencing CrashLoopBackOff (90% of pods) in eu-west-1; 5xx rate spike at 18:02 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T18:00Z rollout for inference-service v27 finished but health checks started failing during node-drain batch.

sam-oncall: taking pager. starting triage. @leah-sre can you check node-drain jobs? seeing CrashLoopBackOff + OOMKilled in pod events.

leah-sre: looking. Node drain completed on a subset of GPU nodes 18:01 UTC then k8s evicted a couple of pods, scheduler rescheduled onto smaller nodes -> OOMs. suspect new resource requests or affinity change in v27.

mia-ml: v27 changed pod `requests.memory` from 8Gi -> 6Gi and removed `nodeSelector: gpu=true` in manifest to enable multi-node scheduling. that might have allowed pods to land on non-gpu nodes without device plugin and failed to allocate GPU, causing container init to crash.

carlos-eng: also saw HPA scale-down event 17:59 -> HPA minReplicas is 1 in config, but our canary-targeting feature flag allowed aggressive scale-to-zero for idle, the flag erroneously flipped during rollout. HPA briefly scaled to 0 then rapidly back up which destabilized the rollout.

priya-support: CS reporting errors for customers sending long-run streaming infer requests — timeouts + 502/503s. scope: eu-west-1 only so far.

sam-oncall: impact acknowledged. customers affected: handful of SLO-critical tenants in eu-west-1. escalating to SEV-2 until containment.

leah-sre: immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout / rollback v27, 2) set HPA minReplicas=2 for inference-service in eu-west-1, 3) cordon the drained nodes (so scheduler doesn't pack onto undersized nodes). proposing commands now.

carlos-eng: agreed. I'm running helm rollback to v26 now.

deploy-bot: running: `helm rollback inference-service 26 --namespace=prod-eu-west-1`

ops-bot: rollback started (job id 98321). Will report status when complete.

leah-sre: while rollback runs, applying HPA safe config:
```bash
kubectl -n prod-eu-west-1 patch hpa inference-service -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 2}}'
```

mia-ml: also toggle feature flag kill-switch for canary auto-scale behavior: `kubectl set data configmap/feature-flags --from-literal=canary-scale-zero=false -n prod-eu-west-1` (config map key: canary-scale-zero).

sam-oncall: @priya-support please send a brief status to affected customers: we have identified a rollout issue affecting eu-west-1, rollback + mitigations underway, no data loss, ETA 20-30m.

priya-support: message posted to customers + CS channel. added note: we will follow up with postmortem. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: rollback completed: release v26 restored, new ReplicaSet stable.

leah-sre: verifying pods... seeing 6/6 inference-service pods Running in eu-west-1, no CrashLoopBackOff now. HPA minReplicas patched -> 2.

carlos-eng: logs from the crashed pods show `failed to attach GPU plugin: no devices` and `OOMKilled` lines. combination of missing nodeSelector + node drain packing onto CPU-only nodes. further root cause: the v27 manifest removed a toleration for `nvidia.com/gpu` node taint — so pods could be scheduled on wrong nodes.

mia-ml: that matches the change. we rolled out a manifest simplification to support multi-arch but missed the affinity/toleration. will open a PR to re-add the taint/toleration and add an admission test.

sam-oncall: good containment. customers still seeing some residual 5xxs but throughput normalized. We'll keep this SEV-2 until full ticketing done and CS confirms customer impact cleared.

priya-support: CS confirms the majority of impacted customers are seeing normal behavior now. flagged two large jobs that retried and succeeded.

leah-sre: actions for next 24h: - emergency rollback notice in release channel, - revert the feature-flag change that allowed scale-to-zero during rollouts, - add admission check for `tolerations` in deployment manifest, - adjust node-drain job to exclude GPU node pools during sensitive rollouts.

carlos-eng: I'll file the postmortem and link PRs: roll back v27, add admission unit test, patch HPA config docs.

sam-oncall: handoff to day oncall in 20m — @mia-ml @leah-sre please follow up. closing timeline note: incident opened 18:02 UTC, rollback completed 18:20 UTC, mitigations applied 18:25 UTC, follow-up actions created.

deploy-bot: incident ticket created: INCIDENT-2026-0034. assigned to carlos-eng for postmortem.

mia-ml: quick recap for postmortem: root cause = manifest regression removing GPU toleration + feature-flag flip enabling aggressive HPA scale-to-zero during rollout + node-drain scheduling behavior -> CrashLoopBackOff + OOMKilled.

priya-support: updating customer comms with final note and postmortem ETA.

leah-sre: thumbs: :thumbsup: good work everyone. adding retrospective items to oncall runbook for node-drain and rollout checklist.

sam-oncall: closing alert channel once CS confirms. thanks team.

ops-bot: closing incident channel placeholder. Remember to run RCA template in 48h and attach metrics (p50/p95 latency, error-rate, rollout timeline).
